menu_path_issues: Every EN path says 'Settings'. The sidebar item in EN is 'Setting' (nav.setting, en.yaml:6, singular). RU 'Настройки' is correct.

Language path: the dropdown order in Language.vue:42-46 is 简体中文, English, Русский. The paths list 'English / Русский / 简体中文'. The button icon is tabler 'language', not a globe, and the list opens on hover or click. The first-run default (menu.ts detectLanguage) is zh, en or ru by OS language, otherwise en.

Add subscription: the dialog has a multi-line textarea (AddProfileDialog.vue), not a single input. Its title is 'Add'/'Добавить'. The footer has Cancel and Add buttons. The Home '+' menu also has an 'Add'/'Добавить' item with a pencil icon, so a user sees two 'Add' labels in the Home dropdown.

Turn the VPN on or off: the Proxy button needs a profile that is selected, otherwise a warning toast appears. Both warnings say 'open Tun' even for the Proxy button (verified). Turning Proxy OFF shows a warning-style toast. Toggling Settings > System Proxy Mode while Proxy is ON also shows the toast 'Proxy is ON/OFF' (MyProxy.vue:435-437), which can confuse users.

Switch routing mode: confirmed that RU hides Direct in the sidebar (MyRule.vue:55), and that the pill is hidden entirely when the profile header global-mode is false (MyRule.vue:35). The same condition removes Rule/Global/Direct from the Rust tray (tray.rs:177 global_mode_disabled). The path 'tray menu > Direct' is therefore not available for those profiles either.

Install the TUN service: the claim 'dialog 'TUN Mode' when pressing Tun in the sidebar' is correct only without admin rights. If the app is already elevated and the service is not, the dialog is service.admin-title (also 'TUN Mode') with the buttons 'Start TUN'/'Install Service'/'Cancel'. The two dialogs are different (MyProxy.vue:480 vs :495).
Choose a server: the path does not mention that URLTest/Fallback-type groups refuse manual selection (toast proxies.auto-group-no-manual-select), so 'pick a node' does not work for all groups.

Settings tabs: the menu_path entries for the Log and Connections tabs are correct. The tab tooltips (setting.tab.app, setting.tab.core, sec-nav.*) are verified. The Rules tab has sub-tabs (Now/Group/Providers/Ignore) not covered.

The latest published release v2.0.0-rc01 is a PRERELEASE. The latest non-prerelease according to GitHub is v1.0.20, which I did not read. UI strings for the stable v1.0.20 may differ from those listed here.

In v2.0.0-rc01 the default desktop download (windows-amd64.msi, macos-*.dmg, linux-*.deb without a suffix) is a new Rust + Slint build. It uses the same src/locales/*.yaml (src-rs/src/i18n.rs:11-13) and mirrors the Vue UI. The *-wails and *-electron builds use the Vue UI directly. Citations here are to the Vue files and, where checked, Slint files. I did not run the app, so layout and hidden/visible states come from source reading.

The desktop app has no 'Connect/Disconnect' button, no connection timer, and no 'Connected/Disconnected' text. The on/off state is the sidebar buttons 'Proxy' and 'Tun' (dot indicator) plus toasts like 'Proxy is ON'. Android and Android TV have a separate VPN UI (release notes mention 'Play/Pause toggles VPN'); it is not covered here and the Android sources were not read.

The task hint 'Proxy section (rocket icon)' is a mismatch: the rocket icon belongs to the Proxies navigation tab (MyNav.vue:28), not to the Proxy on/off button (access-point icon, MyProxy.vue:457). The 'TUN switch' is the sidebar button 'Tun' (shown uppercase by CSS).

RU: with the interface language set to Russian the Direct mode button 'Прямой' is hidden in the sidebar (MyRule.vue:55). A user following a Russian-language guide will not see 'Прямой' in the mode pill.
Several Settings tabs and many header buttons are icon-only; the quoted names are tooltip/aria-label texts, shown on hover.

Some long RU strings were cut by my line limit and are marked as such: tun-unavailable (ru.yaml:26) and proxies.auto-group-no-manual-select (ru.yaml:270). All other quoted EN/RU pairs were read in full from en.yaml/ru.yaml at tag v2.0.0-rc01. The en.yaml and ru.yaml files are line-for-line aligned (703 lines each) so no key falls back to EN, but I did not run a programmatic key-set diff (no yaml module available).
Orphan keys (defined, not found in UI code): home.download, home.upload, home.memory, tun-warning (not found). Do not mention these as UI elements.
Hard-coded non-localised labels seen in the UI: 'Tun Stack' (MyTun.vue:34), 'HWID', 'Api', 'Secret', 'IPv6', 'Mihomo' (MyConfig.vue). They stay in English in the RU UI.

No 'refresh all subscriptions' control, no QR code, and no 'copy subscription link' button exist in the desktop UI at this tag, as far as my grep shows. The only per-profile share function is 'Send profile to Prizrak-Box Android TV'.
Per-OS differences (Windows UAC, macOS admin prompt, Linux privileges for TUN) were not examined; the TUN dialog and 'Service Mode' texts are generic.
